name: remitly
description: Read-only Remitly tools for planning international money transfers. Get exchange rate and fee quotes, compare delivery and payment options, check which delivery methods are available between two countries, find cash pickup locations and providers, see mid-market exchange rate trends, and get answers from the Remitly Help Center. After signing in, customers can also review their own recent transfers, transfer receipts, and saved recipients. The plugin can't send money or change an account.

interface.longDescription:
Plan an international money transfer and check on the ones you've already sent, right in the conversation.

Without signing in, you can:
- Get a price quote with the exchange rate, fee, and amount your recipient gets
- Compare delivery and payment options by cost or estimated delivery time
- See which delivery methods, such as bank deposit or cash pickup, are available between two countries
- Find cash pickup locations near a place you name, or near your approximate location if you share it with ChatGPT, and see which cash pickup providers serve a country
- See a chart of how the mid-market exchange rate has moved over the past week, month, or year
- Get answers from the Remitly Help Center about ID documents for verification, payment options, how fees work, receiving money, and sending as a business

After you sign in to your Remitly account, you can also:
- Review your recent transfers, including amounts, status, and expected delivery
- See the full receipt for a transfer, including fees and total charged
- See your saved recipients for a destination country
- Get quotes and compare delivery options using the pricing for your account

Who it's for: Remitly customers, and people considering Remitly, who want to plan a transfer or check on one.

What it can't do:
- It's read-only. It can't send money, cancel or change a transfer, add or edit recipients, or change your account. To send money, continue on Remitly using the link provided.
- Quotes and delivery options are estimates. Rates subject to change. Final amounts are confirmed when you create a transfer on Remitly.
- Rate trend charts show the mid-market rate, not the rate Remitly offers. They don't predict future rates or advise when to send.
- Price quotes currently cover transfers from a growing list of send and destination countries. For other countries, you'll get a link to check on Remitly.
- Your transfers and recipients are shown only for the Remitly account you sign in with. Recipient details are limited to name, delivery type, receiving bank or provider name, the last four digits of a bank account, and whether the recipient is you.

Signing in shares your Remitly account email with the plugin and keeps you connected until you disconnect it in ChatGPT or the sign-in expires.

Delivery options vary depending upon the recipient's location. Payment options vary depending upon the sender's location. Transfer speed is dependent on payment method, delivery method, transaction review and system availability of Remitly and our partners.
capabilities: Get exchange rate and fee quotes
defaultPrompt: What exchange rate and fee would I get sending $200 USD from the U.S. to Mexico?
Where can my recipient pick up cash I send from the U.S. in Monterrey, Mexico?
Show my recent Remitly transfers and their status

positive.description: Public tool, no sign-in needed. Shows the historical mid-market exchange rate for a launched corridor (U.S. to India) as an interactive chart. Checks that the plugin labels it as the mid-market rate, not Remitly's rate, and doesn't forecast.
positive.prompt: How has the exchange rate from U.S. dollars to Indian rupees moved over the past month?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_rate_trend with send_country USA and receive_country IND. Renders the rate trend chart widget with the USD to INR mid-market series, the current mid-market rate and its as-of date. The reply says this is the mid-market rate, not the rate Remitly offers, makes no prediction about future rates and gives no send-now-or-wait advice, and includes the returned remitly.com link. No sign-in is requested.

positive.description: Public tool, no sign-in needed. Lists the delivery methods available from the U.S. to Mexico and answers whether cash pickup is one of them.
positive.prompt: What delivery methods can I use to send money from the U.S. to Mexico? Is cash pickup one of them?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls lookup_delivery_methods for USA/USD to MEX/MXN. Renders the delivery methods widget listing each method returned for the corridor with its providers, answers whether cash pickup is included based on that list, and includes the returned remitly.com link. It does not quote fees or compare speeds, and no sign-in is requested.

positive.description: Signed-in quote. Connect the Remitly test account first. The plugin previews the exchange rate, fee and receive amount using that account's own pricing, not the public list price. It's an estimate only; no transfer is created.
positive.prompt: Using my Remitly account's own pricing, not the public list price, what exchange rate and fee would I get sending $398 USD from the U.S. to Mexico?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_price_quote_personalized with from_country US, to_country MX and amount 398 (anchor SEND, or omitted, since it defaults to SEND). Renders the price quote widget with the send amount, the receive amount in MXN, the exchange rate and the fee as the quote returns them. The reply doesn't describe the amounts as public list prices or ask the customer to sign in; get_price_quote_public isn't used (its summary would end with "(list price — sign in for the personalized rate)"). If the account has a promotion, the reply may say promotional pricing was applied. The reply says the amounts are estimates and links to remitly.com to continue. No transfer is created.

positive.description: Signed-in transfer history and receipt. Lists the test account's two most recent transfers, then opens the full receipt for the latest one. Both are cancelled U.S. to Philippines cash pickup transfers, so the receipt has no completion time.
positive.prompt: Show my 2 most recent Remitly transfers, then show the full receipt for the latest one.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_recent_transactions with limit 2 and renders the transfers widget with two Cancelled U.S. to Philippines cash pickup transfers to Test Receiver, each 10 USD to 541.30 PHP, dated Oct 5, 2023. Then calls get_transaction_details for the latest one (reference R70834466242) and shows its receipt: status Cancelled, created date, recipient, send amount 10.00 USD, receive amount 541.30 PHP, exchange rate 1 USD = 54.13 PHP, fee 5.43 USD, total 15.43 USD, payment method, cash pickup through PH Open Network V2. It does not invent a completion time. Values match the transfer on the test account at remitly.com.

positive.description: Signed-in saved recipients for one destination country. Returns display-safe recipient details only. Delivery details come from each recipient's most recent transfer, so a recipient who has never been sent money shows the name only.
positive.prompt: Who are my saved recipients in the Philippines?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_recipients with receive_country PH and lists the test account's three saved Philippines recipients by name: Test Receiver, Abe Friend and Carl Santos. Test Receiver shows cash pickup and its pickup providers; the other two show the name only because they have never been sent a transfer. No full account numbers or ID numbers appear.

negative.description: Domestic payment through another app. The user wants to pay someone in the U.S. with Venmo. That is not an international transfer and not a Remitly service, so the Remitly plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: Send $50 to my roommate on Venmo for rent.
negative.expected_behavior: No Remitly tool is called. ChatGPT answers without the plugin, for example by explaining how to pay in the Venmo app.

negative.description: Cryptocurrency price. The user asks for a Bitcoin price, which Remitly doesn't offer and none of the plugin's tools cover, so the plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: What's the price of Bitcoin right now?
negative.expected_behavior: No Remitly tool is called. The plugin does not present crypto prices or exchange rates as an answer.

negative.description: Interest rates, not exchange rates. The word 'rates' could be mistaken for an exchange-rate question, but mortgage refinancing has nothing to do with sending money, so the plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: Should I refinance my mortgage now that rates dropped?
negative.expected_behavior: No Remitly tool is called, including get_rate_trend and the price quote tools. ChatGPT answers without the plugin.

review.commerce_description: This plugin doesn't sell products, process payments, or move money. Every tool is read-only: it shows estimated exchange rates and fees, delivery and payment options, cash pickup locations and providers, mid-market rate history, Help Center answers, and, after sign-in, the customer's own transfers and saved recipients. To send money, customers continue on remitly.com or in the Remitly app.

publication.release_notes: Updated country availability. The plugin is no longer available in Canada.
